title: Zevia Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Net Sales at the High End of Outlook; Adjusted EBITDA Exceeds Outlook Zevia PBC (“Zevia” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ZVIA), the Company bringing naturally delicious, zero sugar, clean-label beverages, today reported results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
